plugins.name: review-tour
plugins.description: Review a code change in the order it runs: a guided CodeTour in VS Code with real diffs, one highlighted block per step.

plugins.name: flow-diff
plugins.description: Draw a before/after flow diff of a design change as swimlane diagrams: new, changed, removed and unchanged parts in colour, every arrow labelled and numbered, every box explained.

plugins.name: issue-check
plugins.description: Check a GitHub issue before work starts: can it be implemented, what blocks it in the code or in open issues and PRs, is the description current, is it still relevant.

plugins.name: explain-issue
plugins.description: Explain a GitHub issue in plain words, with context from the code and the ADRs: the ask, why it exists as a concrete timeline, where it lands in the code, what is decided, what is still open, how to start.

plugins.name: rewrite-issue-after-check
plugins.description: Rewrite a GitHub issue's description from the findings of issue-check, and write the still-open design decisions into it. Shows the before and after and asks before it edits.
